result.reason: The operative clause satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback limits. It is not minimal because it extends every required policy for one year after termination, an obligation not required by either position; it also imposes cyber/privacy coverage unconditionally rather than only when HDI processes Customer Data. The addition does not alter unrelated provisions or create an apparent contradiction, although applying the post-term requirement indiscriminately to occurrence-based CGL and workers' compensation coverage is broader than necessary.
